privacy-policy-intro: BiteTribe (“we”, “our”, “us”) respects your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how information is collected, used, and shared when you use the BiteTribe mobile application and related services (the “App”).
privacy-policy-account-intro: When you sign in to BiteTribe, we collect:
privacy-policy-account-email: Your email address (if you sign in with email)
privacy-policy-account-profile: Your display name and profile image (if provided by Google or Apple sign-in)
privacy-policy-account-pronouns: Your pronouns, if you add them to your profile. They are shown on your profile when it is public and are not used for anything else
privacy-policy-account-note: Authentication is handled securely via Firebase Authentication.
privacy-policy-content-intro: When you use the App, you create and share content, including:
privacy-policy-content-location: Location data associated with a Bite
privacy-policy-content-note: This content is stored to provide the core functionality of the App.
privacy-policy-location-intro: Location data is used only when you create or view Bites to:
privacy-policy-location-attach: Attach a location to a Bite
privacy-policy-location-note: Location access is optional and controlled by your device permissions.
privacy-policy-location-photo: If a photo you add to a Bite contains a location, we keep that location with the Bite even when you choose a different location for it, so you can switch back to it while editing. Only you can see it, and it is deleted together with the Bite or your account.
privacy-policy-usage-intro: We may collect basic usage data to understand how the App is used and to improve it, such as:
privacy-policy-usage-note: This data is collected using Firebase services and does not personally identify you.
privacy-policy-dietary-body: If you set dietary choices in the settings, such as vegan, gluten-free or halal, we store them privately on your account. Only you can read them. Some of them, such as halal, kosher, avoiding pork or alcohol, or a food intolerance, can reveal your religion or your health. We store those only with your explicit consent, which you can withdraw in the settings at any time; withdrawing it removes them.
privacy-policy-dietary-note: We use your dietary choices only to show you food that fits them and to keep ads that conflict with them away from you. We never infer them from what you search, save or post, never send them to analytics or to an advertising network, and delete them when you delete your account.
privacy-policy-use-intro: We use the collected information to:
privacy-policy-use-operate: Provide and operate the BiteTribe App
privacy-policy-use-share: Allow users to create, view, and share Bites
privacy-policy-use-improve: Improve app performance, stability, and user experience
privacy-policy-use-communicate: Communicate important updates related to the App
privacy-policy-security-storage: Data is stored using Google Firebase services.
privacy-policy-security-measures: Reasonable technical and organizational measures are used to protect your information.
privacy-policy-security-note: No system can be guaranteed 100% secure, but we take security seriously.
privacy-policy-sharing-no-sale: We do not sell your personal data.
privacy-policy-sharing-intro: Your data may be shared only in the following cases:
privacy-policy-sharing-public: Public content you choose to share (e.g. Bites) is visible to other users
privacy-policy-sharing-providers: With service providers (such as Firebase) strictly to operate the App
privacy-policy-services-intro: BiteTribe uses the following third-party services:
privacy-policy-services-ai: Google Gemini on Vertex AI, only when you tap Generate on a Bite: it receives the photo, dish name, restaurant and position to suggest a description
privacy-policy-services-ai-explain: Google Gemini on Vertex AI, when you tap Explain me on a Bite: it receives the Bite's public dish name, restaurant, city, country and photo to explain the dish. The explanation is stored and shown to other users
privacy-policy-services-ai-moderation: Google Gemini on Vertex AI, automatically for what you publish: the text of reviews, replies, display names, your profile and your Bites, and every Bite, profile, restaurant and Bite Trail photo you upload, are checked for objectionable content as they are published. Photos stored before this check existed are checked once. Only the verdict is kept, filed under a hash of the text or photo, never the text or photo itself
privacy-policy-services-note: These services are provided by Google and are subject to Google’s privacy policies.
privacy-policy-rights-intro: Depending on your location, you may have the right to access your personal data, request correction or deletion of your data, and withdraw consent where applicable.
privacy-policy-rights-delete: You can delete your account and associated data by contacting us.
privacy-policy-children-body: BiteTribe is not intended for children under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children.
privacy-policy-changes-body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Changes will be reflected on this page with an updated “Last updated” date.
privacy-policy-contact-intro: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or your data, you can contact us at:

support-intro: Help with BiteTribe: how to reach us, and what to send so we can answer quickly.
support-contact-intro: Email us and we will help.
support-response-time: We usually reply within a few working days.
support-include-intro: So we can help without a round of questions, please tell us:
support-include-account-email: The email address you use to sign in to BiteTribe.
support-include-device: Your device and its operating system version.
support-include-version: The BiteTribe version and build number.

support-common-sign-in: Cannot sign in: use the same method you registered with, whether that is email and password, Google or Apple.
support-common-photo-upload: A photo did not upload: open the Bite and tap Retry. Uploads need a connection and are retried once you are back online.
support-common-location-currency: Wrong place or currency on a Bite: edit the Bite and set its position. The currency follows the position of the Bite, not the position of your device.
support-common-notifications: No notifications: check that they are switched on both in BiteTribe settings and in your device settings.
support-report-intro: If you see a Bite or a review that does not belong on BiteTribe, email us with a link or a screenshot and we will look at it.
table-session-confirm-intro: Check that this is the table you are sitting at before you go on.
table-session-share-location: Optional: share roughly where you are, so the restaurant can spot codes being misused. It changes nothing about your order.
table-session-active-intro: {{restaurant}} has your table open, so you can order from here.
table-session-pending-intro: Ordering opens as soon as a member of staff confirms your table. You can stay on this page.
table-session-menu-soon: The menu and ordering are on their way.
table-session-left-intro: Anyone else at table {{table}} is still ordering. Scan the code again if you want to come back.
table-session-refused-unknownToken: This code isn't one of ours, or it has been typed in wrong.
table-session-refused-restaurantNotFound: The restaurant behind this code is no longer on BiteTribe.
table-session-refused-restaurantInactive: This restaurant isn't set up to receive orders at the moment.
table-session-refused-tableNotFound: This code doesn't match any table in the restaurant.
table-session-refused-tableDisabled: This table is out of service right now.
table-session-refused-tokenSuperseded: This code has been replaced. There should be a newer one on the table.
table-session-refused-tokenRevoked: This code has been withdrawn and no longer works.
table-session-refused-restaurantClosed: The restaurant is closed right now.
table-session-refused-menuMissing: There is no menu to order from yet.
table-session-refused-menuUnavailable: Nothing on the menu is available right now.
table-session-next-askStaff: Ask a member of staff and they will sort it out.
table-session-next-tryLater: Try again in a little while.
table-session-next-rescanCode: Scan the code on the table again.
table-session-failed-offline: Your phone couldn't get through. Check your connection and try again.
table-session-failed-rateLimited: That was a lot of tries at once. Wait a moment and try again.
table-session-failed-unknown: Something went wrong on our side. Try again, or ask a member of staff.
public-menu-refused-restaurantInactive: This restaurant isn't on BiteTribe at the moment.
public-menu-refused-menuMissing: This restaurant hasn't published a menu yet.
public-menu-refused-menuEmpty: There's nothing on this menu yet.
public-menu-failed-body: Your phone couldn't get through. Check your connection and try again.
table-session-menu-only-disabled: This restaurant doesn't take orders from the table, but you can read the menu here.
table-session-menu-only-paused: They've paused new orders for a moment. You can still read the menu.
table-order-cart-empty: Nothing yet. Add something from the menu above.
table-order-unconfirmed-notSent: Your order hasn't reached {{restaurant}} yet — your phone had no connection.
table-order-unconfirmed-unknown: We couldn't tell whether {{restaurant}} got your order for table {{table}}.
table-order-unconfirmed-safe: It's saved on your phone. Check it and we'll find out — it can't be ordered twice.
table-order-placed-already: This one was already with the kitchen, so you haven't ordered it twice.
table-order-placed-heading: Your order is with the kitchen
table-order-cancelled-no-reason: The restaurant cancelled this one. Ask a member of staff if you need to know why.
table-order-status-stale: We've lost touch with the restaurant, so this may be out of date.
table-order-blocked-title: You can't order here right now
table-order-blocked-menuCurrencyMissing: This menu doesn't say what currency its prices are in, so orders can't be taken from it yet.
table-order-price-was: It was {{was}} and it is now {{now}}.
table-order-refused-sessionNotFound: You aren't at this table any more. Scan the code on the table again.
table-order-refused-sessionNotActive: Your table has been closed. Scan the code again to start over.
table-order-refused-sessionExpired: You were away a while, so we let your table go. Scan the code again.
table-order-refused-visitClosed: The restaurant has closed this table. Ask a member of staff.
table-order-refused-orderingUnavailable: They've stopped taking orders from the table for now.
table-order-refused-tableNotOrderable: This table isn't taking orders at the moment. Ask a member of staff.
table-order-refused-menuMissing: The menu has gone. Ask a member of staff.
table-order-refused-menuCurrencyMissing: This menu doesn't say what currency its prices are in, so orders can't be taken from it yet.
table-order-refused-emptyOrder: There's nothing in your order yet.
table-order-refused-itemMissing: {{item}} is no longer on the menu. Take it out and send the rest.
table-order-refused-itemUnavailable: {{item}} isn't available right now. Take it out and send the rest.
table-order-refused-priceChanged: The price of {{item}} has changed. Check it and send again.
table-order-refused-extraMissing: {{extra}} is no longer offered with {{item}}. Take it off and send the rest.
table-order-refused-extraPriceChanged: The price of {{extra}} on {{item}} has changed. Check it and send again.
table-order-refused-optionMissing: A choice for {{option}} on {{item}} is no longer offered. Take it out, add it again and send.
table-order-refused-optionRequired: {{item}} needs a choice for {{option}}. Take it out, add it again and send.
table-order-refused-currencyChanged: The menu's prices have changed currency. Check your order and send again.
table-assistance-requestBill-open: The bill has been asked for
table-assistance-requestBill-acknowledge: Your bill is on its way.
table-assistance-refused-tableNotAttende: The restaurant doesn't have you seated at this table. Ask a member of staff.
table-assistance-refused-cooldown: You've only just asked. Give them a moment before asking again.
table-assistance-stale: We've lost touch with the restaurant, so this may be out of date.
table-bill-empty: Nothing has been ordered at this table yet.
table-bill-unsettled: Settle the bill with the restaurant when you're ready.
table-bill-settled: The restaurant has marked this bill as paid.
table-bill-settled-cash: The restaurant has marked this bill as paid in cash.
table-bill-settled-card: The restaurant has marked this bill as paid by card.
table-bill-settled-other: The restaurant has marked this bill as paid.
visit-summary-preparing: We're still putting your summary together. Try again in a moment.
visit-summary-expired: This summary is no longer available. Create an account to keep the next one.
visit-summary-empty: Nothing was ordered at this table.
visit-summary-not-a-receipt: This is a summary of what was ordered, not a receipt. Your receipt comes from the restaurant.
visit-summary-email-privacy: We'll use your address for this one email and won't keep it.
visit-summary-email-already-sent: This summary has already been sent. We can't send it again.
visit-summary-email-invalid: That doesn't look like an email address.
visit-summary-email-failed: We couldn't send the email. Please try again.
my-visits-empty: Your visits appear here after you've ordered at a table with a BiteTribe code.
visit-summary-register-copy: Create an account to turn what you ate into a Bite. Your visit stays with you.
dish-bites-empty: Nobody has written about this dish yet.
ate-with-limit-reached: You can tag up to {{max}} people.
ate-with-no-candidates: Follow people to tag them in your Bites.
ate-with-remove-me-message: Your name will no longer appear on this Bite.
ate-with-removed: Your name was removed from this Bite.
ate-with-remove-failed: Your name could not be removed. Please try again.
scan-a-code-with-your-phone-camera-to-in: Scan a code with your phone camera to install BiteTribe.
remove-bite-from-bucket-list-message: Are you sure you want to remove this bite from the bucket list?
menu-category-empty: No items in this category yet.
menu-derived-from-bites-notice: Put together from guests’ Bites, not by the restaurant. Prices are averages of what guests paid.
report-bite-message: Why should we look at this Bite? Its author is not told who reported it.
report-bite-sent: Thanks. We will look at this Bite.
report-bite-already-sent: You have already reported this Bite.
report-bite-failed: The report could not be sent. Please try again.
report-review-message: Why should we look at this? Nobody in the thread is told who reported it.
report-review-sent: Thanks. We will look at it.
report-review-failed: The report could not be sent. Please try again.
report-profile-message: Why should we look at this profile? They are not told who reported them.
report-profile-sent: Thanks. We will look at this profile.
report-profile-already-sent: You have already reported this profile.
report-profile-failed: The report could not be sent. Please try again.
globe-aria-label: Globe with the countries Bites were created in
account-language-prompt-message: Your account is set to {{accountLanguage}}, but the app is showing {{currentLanguage}}. Which language would you like to use?
restaurant-follow-failed: Couldn't follow this restaurant. Try again.
restaurant-unfollow-failed: Couldn't unfollow this restaurant. Try again.
